import { handle, OperationError } from '@jigging/flow'

await handle(async run => {
  const { mode } = run.input as { mode: string }
  if (mode !== 'generation' && mode !== 'test') throw Error('Unsupported deadline control')
  const produced = await run.call({
    operationId: 'produce', slot: 'producer', input: { mode },
    attachments: { candidate: { create: true } },
  })
  if (produced.outcome !== 'done' || !produced.artifacts?.candidate)
    throw Error('Producer did not seal its deadline control')
  const candidate = produced.artifacts.candidate
  try {
    await run.call({
      operationId: 'evaluate', slot: 'evaluate', input: {},
      attachments: { candidate: { read: candidate }, deliverables: { create: true } },
    })
    throw Error('Intentional infinite phase returned normally')
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof OperationError)) throw error
    await run.release({ operationId: 'release-candidate', artifact: candidate })
    return {
      outcome: 'done',
      output: {
        mode, code: error.code, details: error.details ?? null,
        remainingAfterMs: run.deadlineUnixMs - Date.now(),
      },
    }
  }
})
